# Moodsk

> Moodsk is a macOS file and folder icon editor by ajigu. Create icons from images, SF Symbols, text or emoji, apply them individually or in batches, and restore default icons.

## Product facts

- Name: Moodsk. Publisher: ajigu, an independent app studio.
- Requires macOS 14 or later. Supports Apple Silicon Macs.
- Free to download. Editor Pro and paid icon packs are separate in-app purchases.
- Icon rendering and application run locally on the Mac. Apple services handle purchases.
- The app and landing page support English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
- Landing page last updated: 2026-10-08.

## Tutorials

- [Change a folder icon on Mac](https://moodsk.ajigu.com/tutorials/change-folder-icons-on-mac/): Finder and Moodsk workflows.
- [Folder color system](https://moodsk.ajigu.com/tutorials/folder-color-system-on-mac/): Organize project folders with repeatable colors.
- [Folder icons with text](https://moodsk.ajigu.com/tutorials/folder-icons-with-text/): Edit text labels and understand Editor Pro output actions.
- [Chinese tutorials](https://moodsk.ajigu.com/zh-hans/tutorials/): The same guides in Simplified Chinese.
